review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, regression design self-review
review.decision: Decode external Markdown link entities only when terminated, while matching the installed paired resolver for local destinations.
review.notes: The independent same-head review found that legacy substring matching removes ordinary query parameter separators. The assertions observe the actual rendered link action and preserve the local resolver's legacy decoding.

cases.description: Markdown preview decoding preserves ordinary URL query boundaries
cases.setup: Render standalone HTTPS or mailto links with raw copy, region or ordinary query parameters and an explicitly escaped separator. Include a paired local Markdown reference using a named character reference accepted by the server.
cases.action: Tap each accessible link and inspect the native callback and the local preview request reference.
cases.expected: Raw external query parameters are preserved. Explicitly terminated HTML entities decode once. The paired file path still matches existing Markdown extraction. External actions never use the local preview callback.
